About

Built for complexity.
Wired for delivery.

I'm a Senior TPM who thrives at the intersection of technology, people, and delivery pressure. My career has moved from rolling out 4G BTS networks across UP West to launching a flagship OTT platform for one of Southeast Asia's largest broadcasters — each chapter pushing me to manage bigger programs, harder constraints, and more distributed teams.

At Irdeto, I run a multi-client program spanning Tata Play, Astro Malaysia, and ITV UK — coordinating 55+ engineers across India, Malaysia, and the UK. I own end-to-end delivery governance, executive stakeholder comms, and release cadence across four parallel workstreams and three time zones. The Astro Sooka launch is Irdeto's fastest client delivery on record.

At Junglee Games, I built the entire MarTech operating model from zero — intake process, JIRA framework, sprint cadence — and made delivery repeatable within 60 days. Ran five live real-money gaming apps simultaneously while hitting a regulatory GST deadline with zero downtime.

I'm most valuable when the program is large, the stakeholders are senior, and the delivery clock is ticking.
